summary: Comprehensive ease-of-replication analysis comparing all 10 researched YouTube niches — Math Education, Tech Explainers, Stickman Animation, Horror Commentary, Mythical Creatures, and GTA Kids. Ranks each by difficulty, cost, time investment, tools needed, and real NexLev revenue data. Includes risk warnings (COPPA, demonetization) and a final recommendation matrix showing Math Education and Tech Explainers as the easiest to replicate with the best risk-adjusted returns.
